By invoking the name 'Sreeja', one can call upon this divine power to manifest abundance and prosperity in their lives, bringing a sense of peace, security, and fulfillment. It serves as a constant reminder to remain connected to the divine source of wealth and prosperity.

In ancient India, it was common for girls to be named after virtues or qualities they were believed to embody. Sreeja is thus a name that signifies a deep sense of faith and commitment.

In this context, Sreeja could be seen as a name that signifies the blessing of the goddess Sri upon an individual, especially a child.
